description: PAID $0.005 USDC per successful call. Screens a person, company or vessel against US OFAC SDN + non-SDN, the UK Sanctions List and Canada's Consolidated Autonomous Sanctions List (SEMA/JVCFOA). Fuzzy, transliteration-aware matching. Returns result (potential_match / no_match) and matches with score, strength (strong/possible), listed name and the alias that matched, list, programs, DOB, countries, listing date and flags. Invalid input is not charged.

country.description: Nationality or address country; mismatches are flagged

dob.description: Date or year of birth (YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD). People whose listed birth year differs by more than 1 are down-ranked and flagged.

minScore.description: Match threshold 0.70-1.00 (default 0.85). Lower finds more spelling variants and more false positives.

type.description: Restrict to people, companies/organisations or vessels (default any)

name: screen_name
title: Sanctions screening: one name
